notes.title: UPDATE - V1.1.24
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
sorry for the long silence, we had to transition to a new project and couldn't find the time to do the updates we wanted. Now finally that our new project has been revealed, we can go back and do necessary updates to Block'hood.

The latest update addresses things that the community has requested.
Hope to do more fixes if necessary soon,

Update notes:
-New resource exchange between 'hood in world mode. All hoods are interconnected creating surplus and deficits between each other.
-Re-balancing of resource inputs / outputs
-Bug fixes

notes.title: UPDATE V 1.1
notes.notes:
Block'hood is now updated!

We have included fixes and updates based on community comments and a few new languages.

Changes Log:
-Feature: Key re-mapping for shortcuts.
-Feature: 30 save slots instead of 6
-Tutorials available from the beginning.
-'p' shortcut for freeze / unfreeze simulation
-Language support: Hungarian
-Language support: Korean
-Rebalance of costs for recover decay tiles.
-and many bug/optimization fixes.


Coming in next update:
-Italian support 
-New Blocks

notes.title: Block hood moves into full release May 11
notes.notes: The highly-stylised community architecture management project, Block’hood [official site], is moving out of early access on 11 May and plopping its futuristic boxes into the spacious environs of full release. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: FINAL RELEASE MAY 11TH
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,
Thanks for your patience and support for the last year. We know it's been a while since the last update, but we wanted to be able to share the new content (The story mode) only when it was ready. 
The time has come to finally release Block'hood!

We will continue supporting the game and adding features over time, but we believe that with the addition of the Story Mode, we have reached the end of a chapter.

The final release coming on May 11th will include:
-5 chapter story mode.
-Localization for: Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, French, German and Portuguese.
-Steam achievements
-Optimized
-Re-balanced
-Increased max number of Blocks (from 800 to 3000)
-Agents habitats database
-Unlockable constrains. 

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: [UPDATE] - v08.09 'NAVIGATOR'
notes.notes:
The new update for Block'hood is here! 
We have spent a good amount of time polishing the user navigation and UI so please let us know what you think.

Change Log: 
-Free Orbit camera!
-Block colliders improved
-Input / Output hint by clicking on resources
-Turntable animation
-Increased font size.
-More contrast on the main menu.
-Removed white intro animation.
-Fixed delete bug
-Regeneration of Decay blocks [New Feature]

Change Log:

-Biomes available in world mode
-Wild blocks populate each biome
-Save system expanded via world system
-New Agents - See inhabitants database
-New Blocks - See advanced tab.
